bio: Osteria Orzo continues to offer an authentic taste of a casual and cozy Italian osteria at its Hannam-dong location. Signature offerings on the menu include the white ragù pasta which features home-made fresh pasta drenched in rich meat sauce with mascarpone cheese and truffles. The spicy tagliatelle and the seafood tartare are also among the restaurant's all-time favorites. Reserve a table across from the open kitchen and watch the chefs in action....
